Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR. 
SYK1NGE, HYPODERMIC, DENTAL FOR 
INTERCHANGEABLE NEEDLES 



( Reaffirmed 1998) 



1 . Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for dental hypodermic syringe to be used with interchange- 
able needles conforming to IS : 5 180- 196? 'Specification for needles, hypodermic, dental'. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. I and 2.

FINGER CRIP 



CRUTCH / 

1YPE HANOI E -' 




FIG. I SYRINGE, HYPODERMIC, DENTAL FQR INTERCHANGEABLE NEEDLES 



3. Materials 

3.1 Crutch Handle and Swivel Type Finger Grip — Brass castings conforming to Grade 2 of IS : 292-1961 
'Specification for brass ingots and castings (revised )*. 

3.2 Other Components — Brass rods conforming to Designation CuZn38Pb3 of IS: 3 19- 1968 'Specification for 
free<ucting brass rods and sections (second reWs/on)\ 

4. Requirements 

4.1 Cap — The cap shall be capable of being unscrewed from the barrel with the help of two pivots on it 
and two pins on the crutch type handle, thus avoiding the use of a spanner. Inside the cap a suitable 
polyethylene washer shall be provided to make the syringe liquid tight when the plunger is Inserted in the 
barret. Three spare washers shall be provided with each syringe. 

4.2 Plunger — It shall have a circular groove at Its lower end, as shown In the figure, to facilitate the 
arresting of plunger by the washer In the cap. The plunger shall be brazed to the crutch type handle. 

4.3 Hubs — One short and one long hub shall be provided with each syringe. The hub shall be bored for 
interchangeable needles specified in 15:5180-1969 counterbored for seating of the head on the needle. The 
tip of the inner barrel shall press the needle head in the hub when assembled. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The finished syringe shall be free from defects which mar the appearance and Impair the serviclabllity 
and durability. 

5.2 The syringe shall be capable of easy and ready disassembly for complete sterilization.

6. Marking— Each syringe shall be marked with manufacturer's name, Initials or trade-mark; and the 
country of manufacture. 



6.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

7. Packing — The syringe shall be either wrapped In wax paper or put In a polyethylene bag and th 
packed In carton In accordance with the trade practice, or the packing may be done as agreed to betwe 
the purchaser and the supplier.
